## Summary

Describe the behavior or research change.

## Validation

- [ ] `ruff check src tests`
- [ ] `python -m pytest`
- [ ] No secrets, market data, logs, or generated backtests are included
- [ ] PIT timing and execution assumptions are documented
- [ ] English and Chinese user documentation are updated when needed

## Quant Research Checklist

- [ ] Economic hypothesis stated
- [ ] In-sample/out-of-sample split stated
- [ ] Costs and slippage included
- [ ] Parameter and cross-section stability checked
- [ ] Failed variants reported
